reason: The PR replaces two per-route DistanceSegment arrays with one cumulative-distance vector and changes route-segment distance reads to prefix subtraction. This is a bounded solver data-structure optimization on the C++ local-search path; route move costs and the search trajectory can change if indices or arithmetic are wrong.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Storing one cumulative route-distance vector instead of separate prefix and suffix DistanceSegment vectors may reduce per-route memory and remove repeated segment merges while preserving O(1) route-segment distance queries.
causal_chain: Route::update builds cumulative distances in one forward pass; SegmentBefore and SegmentAfter read prefix values or subtract from the total; SegmentBetween subtracts two prefixes. Local-search operators consume these values when ranking route moves.
structural_trigger: CVRP local-search workloads with long routes and many SegmentBefore, SegmentAfter, and SegmentBetween distance queries; short-route cases are controls.
activation_probe: Count Route::update calls, segment-distance queries, allocated bytes for route distance summaries, local-search move evaluations, accepted moves, nodes, and incumbent timestamps in paired pinned builds.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze CVRP cases by customer count and route-length distribution before hidden outcomes; include long-route high-query cases and short-route controls, with all seeds and timeouts retained.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared PyVRP source driver on the pinned CVRP instance panel. Instrument paired source builds to verify the cumulative-distance path is read by active local-search operators and independently check every original-instance route.
mathematical_risk: An incorrect prefix index or subtraction could produce a wrong route distance, change move acceptance, or leave an invalid objective. Compare every segment query with a direct sum on small routes and independently recompute every returned route objective.
independent_check_plan: Run the same public CVRP cases on base and PR; independently verify capacity and route visits and recompute total distance on original instances. Add exhaustive segment-distance comparisons across all intervals in small routes.
hidden_generalization_plan: Use hidden CVRP panels stratified by customer count and route length under paired fixed budgets and seeds; report verified normalized-gap trajectories, time-to-target, per-family regressions, and memory.
overlap_review: PR #700 simplifies the broader Route representation, #687 removes concatenation-scheme indices, and #720 targets LocalSearch load/insert/clear costs for ILS. Keep this task specific to cumulative distance storage and segment-query arithmetic; distinct snapshots and workload mechanisms are required for separate tasks.
resource_risk: A single cumulative vector lowers stored route-summary data, but interval subtraction can add arithmetic on hot paths and any cache policy must remain coherent after route edits.
